newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol says LPG price freeze removed from Aug 2.
newsitem.headline: Repsol says LPG price freeze removed from Aug 2.

text.p: The Spanish government has removed the price freeze imposed on liquid petroleum gas (LPG), a spokesman for energy group Repsol said on Tuesday.
"The removal of the freeze was announced in the official state bulletin, effective as of August 2," the spokesman said.
The government announced plans to remove the cap earlier this year.

"The system of determining maximum prices for public sale, before taxes (of these products) will be determined in function of the following factors: international prices, transport and marketing costs," Spain said in its Official State Bulletin on August 1.
The price cap had been weighing on results at gas supplier Gas Natural and its main shareholder Repsol.
